title: gDNA Extraction from Nucleated Blood Using FTA Elute Cards
author: Livia Gerber

steps.title: Punch FTA card and sterilize
steps.instruction: Punch two 3 mm discs from an FTA elute card into a 2 mL tube; sterilize the puncher (e.g., flame) between samples to prevent cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Wash punches
steps.instruction: Wash the punches twice with low‑TE buffer and once with ddH₂O: for each wash add 500 µL of the appropriate solution to the 2 mL tube, vortex vigorously for 5 s, then remove the entire 500 µL without removing the punches. Process samples in batches of eight or fewer to avoid prolonged exposure.

substeps.instruction: Wash 1: add 500 µL low‑TE, vortex 5 s, remove 500 µL
Wash 2: add 500 µL low‑TE, vortex 5 s, remove 500 µL
Wash 3: add 500 µL ddH₂O, vortex 5 s, remove 500 µL

steps.title: Add TE, Proteinase K, and bead
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL TE, 10 µL Proteinase K, and one high‑quality 5 mm stainless‑steel bead (e.g., Qiagen 69989) to each tube.

steps.title: Overnight proteinase digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes overnight at 56 °C on a thermal shaker set to 500 rpm.

steps.title: Pulse‑vortex and add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the shaker, pulse‑vortex each sample for 1 min, then add an additional 10 µL Proteinase K to each tube.

steps.title: Heat‑block incubation
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a heat block and incubate 1–2 h at 56 °C while shaking at 800 rpm. Verify that punches are fully lysed; if not, continue incubation with intermittent pulse‑vortexing until lysed.

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Cool samples to room temperature, add 1.5 µL RNase A to each tube, and incubate 30 min at 37 °C with shaking at 500 rpm to further break down punches.

steps.title: DNA clean‑up with Zymo kit
steps.instruction: Clean the lysate using the Zymo Genomic Clean & Concentrator kit per manufacturer’s protocol: add 800 µL ChIp DNA binding buffer to the lysate, perform the second wash, then dry‑spin for 2 min. Elute DNA in 25 µL Tris‑Cl (pH 8.5) pre‑heated to 60 °C.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration using a Qubit fluorometer with the dsDNA Broad‑Range (BR) assay (preferred over HS due to possible high concentrations).

steps.title: Assess purity with Nanodrop
steps.instruction: Determine purity ratios (260/230 and 260/280) using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer or equivalent device.

steps.title: Evaluate fragment length
steps.instruction: Assess fragment size distribution on a TapeStation 4150 (Genomic DNA ScreenTape); with a 25 µL elution volume, typical mean concentration is 101.25 ng/µL (range 17–323 ng/µL), overall yield ≈2.5 µg from two 3 mm punches, and expected fragment size 10–14 kb.
